nom: MAC Hyper Real Skincanvas Waterlight Cream Moisturizer

avis.texte: A bit pricey, but worth it for the quality. Must have for a beat face

The MAC Cosmetics Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is a nourishing facial moisturizer that effectively helps prep the skin with a supportive layer of hydration before applying makeup products. It glides onto the skin very creamy and provides a healthy-looking glow. I love that this skin does not cause me sensitivity issues despite containing fragrance, and its especially love the way the way it makes my skin super soft.
I've been a fan of the regular hyper real, decided to try this out and the finish it gives your skin especially as my skin is aging.

avis.titre: Please make this in a refill size!
avis.texte: I love this stuff so much. It's intensely hydrating but still plays nicely with other products and makeup without pilling or peeling. I even love it in the pm over my Tazarotene. Please make this in a refill size/package Mac I am begging you.

For me it hydrated my dry areas without feeling heavy or leaving my T zone feeling greasy. Makeup went on smoother and look more natural. It gives a soft, healthy glow not shiny, not matte, just balanced. I definitely noticed my makeup looked more even and less textured when I used it. If you have combo skin and want something that preps your skin without overdoing it, this is a solid option. Just use a lighter amount on oily areas. Overall? It does what it claims. Smooths, hydrates, and helps makeup sit better. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

My skin is seriously try like the Sahara desert and this moisturizer has came in handy to be my savior more times than one I was first introduced to this product when I went to get my make up done at the MAC store they asked me what my skin dry or oily. I replied it was dry like the Sahara desert, and my stylist applied the hyperreal moisturizer before she begin to apply my primer and make up and ever since then I have been obsessed with this product, it moisturizes your skin without leaving oiliness or an overcast. It's lightweight and lightly fragrance perfect base for your makeup Or skin care routine.

avis.titre: Loved using it before putting on makeup
avis.texte: I thoroughly enjoy enjoy using this product, especially before starting my makeup routine. I put it on about 10 minutes before so it's able to absorb into my skin. I thought the overall texture of the product was smooth and even cooling. I would definitely buy this product again once I finish it. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Favorite morning moisturizer before spf and makeup
avis.texte: Mac did an amazing job with the formulation of this moisturizer! If you are a multiple step girly with spf, makeup, etc. this is the moisturizer for you! It hydrates and absorbs beautifully without pilling (—crumbling into little balls). Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Lightweight Hydration with a Natural Glow
avis.texte: I've been using MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream, and I'm genuinely impressed with how lightweight it feels. The texture is smooth and almost airy, absorbing quickly without leaving any heaviness or greasiness. My skin feels hydrated, soft, and looks naturally radiant. It works beautifully under makeup and gives that fresh, healthy glow without looking shiny. Perfect for daily use if you like hydration that feels weightless but still effective. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Solid cream, may irritate certain skin types.
avis.texte: I believe this is a solid cream with a good, almost airy, texture. Not too heavy, but still moisturizing with a neutral fragrance. Unfortunately, there was something in it that seemed to irritate my skin, which is not an issue I've had with other facial moisturizers. It wasn't major irritation, but caused a very slight burning feeling. I think this would be a good cream for most people, but may not be safe for those with sensitive skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

Great lightweight moisturizer that works well under makeup. It's become my go to in my morning routine especially when I wear dewy foundations. I've already purchased a backup jar so I don't inconveniently run out.

This cream is lightly hydrating and sinks in quickly, leaving a slight film of Dimethicone that helps prep skin for makeup. I'm a huge fan of silicone-based primers for the same reasons this cream works so well under makeup. It smooths over texture and has a blurring effect that's very flattering even on its own. I actually used it in place of a my primer for a few days and my foundation looked and wore just as good as usual. As a moisturizer it wasn't as hydrating as my combo/dry skin likes. I preferred layering it over my usual day cream for extra moisture and the texture-smoothing benefits. I think if you have oily or true combo skin this cream by itself would be sufficient, but overall I enjoyed it more as a part of my makeup routine than as a new skincare staple! The added fragrance is light and cause me irritation, but it's unnecessary and might be an issue if you have sensitive skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This is a great water cream. Personally, I have drier skin, so I like using it as skin prep before makeup instead of my primary moisturizer or night cream. It offers just the right amount of hydration and allows my makeup to apply smoothly when I use it as skin prep. My skin absorbs it perfectly and it doesn't slip or feel sticky on my skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.
So soft and moist my face feel very soft and it's glasses it's good for dry skin I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

I've found myself reaching for the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream every single morning since first trying it on my sensitive, combination skin, and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The sturdy glass jar has a sleek, satin-like finish that feels effortlessly luxurious. But the texture of the cream is where it truly shines—it's so lightweight and almost "bouncy," sinking into the skin instantly without any of that annoying tackiness! It feels cooling and refreshing on the skin, and the scent is subtly fresh without being overpowering. What I love most is how it creates a perfectly smooth, hydrated "canvas" for makeup—my foundation has never looked more seamless. If you're looking for a glow that looks like you actually drank enough water, this is it! XD I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I loved this moisturizer! It gave me perfectly glowing skin without the greasy look. I love how thick the cream is and enjoy that a little goes a long way. I've adored the way it makes my face feel day and night! I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

This moisturizer is one of my favorites. Very thick and hydrating but I'd say it's best for combo skin as it juts sets up a nice silky base for your makeup but you can totally wear it on its own and it really makes your skin super soft and silky.

This moisturizer feels lightweight but deeply hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness. My skin looks smoother and more plump after using it, and it's been especially helpful for keeping my dry skin hydrated during the winter months. The packaging is a bit inconvenient and can be slippery to handle, but the product itself layers really well under makeup and is a great option if you want hydration with a fresh, water-light feel. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This moisturizer feels lightweight but deeply hydrating, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness. My skin looks smoother and more plump after using it, and it's been especially helpful for keeping my dry skin hydrated during the winter months. The packaging is a bit inconvenient and can be slippery to handle, but the product itself layers really well under makeup and is a great option if you want hydration with a fresh, water-light feel.

The MAC Hyper Real Skin Canvas Water Light Cream has a beautiful, lightweight texture and gives the skin a smooth, hydrated look without feeling heavy or greasy. It layers well under makeup and definitely creates a nice, healthy glow. Unfortunately, after a few uses I noticed it started to clog my pores, which was disappointing because I really wanted to love it. That said, I think it could work great for people who aren't prone to congestion. Overall, it's a high-quality product with a lovely finish, just not a perfect match for my skin type. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

This is a wonderful cream. Light, moisturizing and with no slimy or off feeling on the skin. I would recommend this to everyone. Helps to keep your skin smooth and hydrated all day without bogging you down or making your skin feel weird. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Lightweight hydration with a natural, luminous finish
avis.texte: The MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream has a lightweight gel-cream texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. From the first application, my skin feels hydrated, smooth, and refreshed with a healthy glow. It works beautifully as a base before makeup, helping foundation apply more evenly and last longer. I love that it provides moisture without feeling heavy and leaves my skin looking naturally radiant rather than shiny. It's perfect for everyday use, especially if you want hydration with a fresh, polished finish.

I can't believe how much I love this moisturizer. I love putting this on my face because first of all, it really is hydrating and moisturizing, second of all, it gives my skin such a natural glow, and third of all, it doesn't make me break out at all. I put this on my face and my neck and it makes my skin soft, glowy, and feel firmer and moisturized. It's definitely my new go to moisturizer. As someone with a dry forehead, especially during the winter, I'm so happy with this moisturizer because it's the only one that's been able to really hydrate my forehead and keep it looking smooth. The moisturizer also smells amazing, but definitely not overpowering. It's just perfect! Highly recommend if you want glowy, moisturized skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I enjoyed the smooth application from this serum. The scent is not overwhelming at all. I applied this serum at night and woke up feeling refreshed and soft. My skin has become softer and delicate. "I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."

It acts like a weightless liquid, forming an ultra-thin film the moment it touches the skin. The cream melts into a super-fine layer, absorbing quickly and giving your skin a beautiful, radiant glow – not greasy or shiny, but a vibrant radiance, like perfectly healthy skin. My pores didn't disappear, but they looked smaller. The product kept my skin soft and moisturized all day long!

I gave this to my mom who is obsessed with skincare for Christmas and she hasn't stopped talking about it. The pores on her nose shrunk a lot and her skin looks more radiant since she's been using it daily. She also says it's so lightweight for how moisturizing it is. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

wow i am so surprised by this skincare product! Firstly it smells and feels amazing on the skin. It has left my skin looking so plump smooth and hydrated. I do feel it has some clogging properties but it has not made me break out or anything it's just something I've noticed. I love it very much and i think i will adopt this as a staple in my routine! I recommend you try it! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

Very nice moisturizer! It's lightweight and goes on smoothly, absorbing well without feeling sticky or tacky. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and incredibly smooth, which makes it perfect for foundation application. I haven't experienced any irritation or negative reactions since I started using it, and it really helps my skin look its best. I received this product free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I love this moisturizer. I am often picky and was nervous to try a new one, but it was the perfect thickness (not too thick, but still super hydrating). It was perfect in the morning under my makeup and hydrating before bed. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is good for all skin types and tones and dermatologist-tested, with ingredients like Japanese Peony Extract, Niacinamide, and Sugar Kelp to help refine pores and enhance radiance. Lightweight, hydrating moisturizer with a "water-light" feel powered by three types of hyaluronic acids. Great for boosting skin moisture, creating a smooth, plump base for makeup, and helping improve texture, radiance, and barrier strength. Good for everyone in my family. *note* did not like the "subtle" chemical it was not strong but some type of added scent/masking agent is lightly chemical smell. I use with a better scented product or at night and it's fine but not my preference! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I have dry, sensitive skin and I'm pretty picky about moisturizers, especially when it comes to how they layer under makeup. This one is a winner. The texture is lightweight but very smooth and silky, and it spreads easily without feeling watery or thin. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and comfortable, not greasy. What really stands out to me is how well it plays with other products. I've used it with vitamin C, sunscreen, and foundation, and I've had zero issues with pilling. It smooths the skin nicely and makes makeup apply more evenly, especially on dry areas. My skin feels soft and balanced after using it, and the finish is natural with a subtle glow, not shiny or sticky. It's not a heavy treatment cream, but as a daily moisturizer and makeup base, it performs extremely well. I've been reaching for it consistently because it just works and makes my skin feel good. Overall: this is a reliable, well-formulated moisturizer that hydrates, layers beautifully, and improves how makeup sits on the skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

Ok, I usually don't like scented products but the scent on this one is so nice and fresh! The cream really absorbs into my skin without leaving it sticky or greasy. It is a lovely base layer under makeup. Great staple in my daily routine both night and day! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I loved this cream. It had a great thick texture, and felt so nice on my skin. Really helped throughout these cold months when my skin tends to dry out so bad. I loved the glowy look it gave me. The only complaint was the scent/fragrance might be a bit much for some skin, however it didn't bother me any, and I have pretty sensitive skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: A Hydrating, Lightweight Primer for a Dewy Finish
avis.texte: This cream works beautifully as a hydrating primer or a lightweight moisturizer. Its texture is unique-truly waterlight-and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy residue. My skin looks hydrated, smooth, and has a subtle, natural glow that works well under makeup or worn alone. I appreciate that it doesn't pill with serums or sunscreen layered underneath. It also has a really nice, subtle and refreshing scent to it which I find to be a huge plus. While it's great for normal to dry skin, those with very oily skin might find it a touch too dewy for daytime wear without powder. A lovely option if you want a fresh, hydrated base with a skin-like finish. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics via Topbox Circle for testing and review purposes.

Finally found a moisturizer that works perfectly under makeup. The MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Cream smells incredible and keeps my skin hydrated all day long. No more dry patches or cakiness under my foundation! It's officially a staple in my routine

It's unusual that a moisturizer can wow me but this waterlight cream by Mac did just that! The texture is divine—it is light and airy but not so light that you're left with nothing. My skin is left moisturized (enough that this can be used at night) while also glowing. I did side by sides with my current moisturizer and the glow difference was very noticeable. No issues with irritation or pilling from makeup. And there is a faint skincare scent but I don't believe there is any added fragrance. Definitely adding this into my daily routine! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

When I heard the name, I thought this would be watery and produce light moisture. I was wrong. This is a very luxurious cream that leaves your skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I have dry skin and using this in the evening in conjunction with the canvas balm has increased the moisture retention in my skin, especially in the current winter months

The MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is an absolute standout for anyone who loves hydrated, healthy-looking skin. The texture is beautifully lightweight—almost cloud-like—yet deeply moisturizing, making it perfect for daily use under makeup or on its own. What I love most is how quickly it absorbs without feeling greasy. My skin feels instantly smoother, plumper, and refreshed, with a subtle glow that looks natural rather than shiny. It layers incredibly well with foundation and actually improves how makeup sits on the skin, giving that smooth, "skin-like" finish MAC is known for. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

I absolutely love how lightweight this moisturizer is! As an oily skin curly I have to find products that don't leave my skin feeling heavy! This moisturizer deeply hydrates my skin without leaving any sort of oily residue! I highly recommend! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."

I really love this cream, it's amazing!!. At first, I thought it might make my face oily, but it doesn't at all. I've been using it for about a month, and my face and neck feel smoother and more even, with smaller-looking pores. I totally recommend it.

avis.titre: Smells so fresh and feels great on the skin.
avis.texte: I love the scent that this cream has. It is like a fresh watery floral scent that lingers for a little while after I put it on that comes from the Japanese peony. I also love the texture its so light and fluffy but keeps me moisturized all day and my favorite part is how it moisturizes my face but does not make it look oily or greasy it just looks fresh. "I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."

I've been using the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream HA³ Moisturizer mainly in the morning, and I love how lightweight and refreshing it feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly, leaves no greasy residue, and keeps my skin feeling smooth and hydrated all day. The texture is silky, and the subtle, clean scent makes it pleasant to use daily. It also works beautifully under makeup. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I never knew MAC did skin care products! This cream felt beautiful on my skin and had a neautral smell, no overpowering fragrance. My skin glowed after applying it and felt very soft and hydrated. I used this cream after I showered. I would definitely recommend this product! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I have fallen in love with this moisturizer! The texture is gel-like, which leaves the skin feeling light and refreshed, and it sinks in fast without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling. My skin looks so fresh and hydrated after using it. The scent is nice and clean. It works great under sunscreen and makeup and doesn't pill or feel heavy at all. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I am overall very happy with this moisturizer. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my skin, yet it leaves my face feeling incredibly soft and hydrated. This would be great for people with sensitive skin as well. I used it in the morning and at night, and noticed within a day that my skin was much more hydrated than it was before I started using it. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I like this moisturizer, it works as a great base before I put on make up. I have dry skin and I feel this makes my skin look dewy without making it look greasy. The texture feels smooth and is easy to apply. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I've only ever tried MAC makeup before and have always had great experiences with them and this was no different. It smelled very nice and it went on so well and didn't leave a tacky feeling or residue. Will definitely be buying and would recommend to so many. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Not bad, but may irritate skin.
avis.texte: Overall, this seems like a decent quality moisturizer with a nice consistency. It also doesn't have a strong smell, for those sensitive to scent. Unfortunately, it did irritate my skin and cause a break out, which isn't an issue with other moisturizers I've used.

This moisturizer feels lightweight and comfortable on my oily-combination skin. I used it in the morning and it worked really well under makeup—no pilling and no heaviness. It kept my skin moisturized throughout the day and left a healthy, glowy finish without feeling greasy. Would recommend! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.
The moisturizer is so lightweight so it absorbs into the skin quickly without leaving it greasy and sticky. I love it

avis.titre: Great moisturizer for the dry winter months!
avis.texte: I love this cream. I use it every morning as a moisturizer after washing my face. I have a basic skincare routine and this is the perfect addition to keeping my skin moisturized during the cold MN winter months. The only downfall to this is it does have a scent to it, but it isn't noticeable once it dries. I would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for a good moisturizer that gets the job done! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

When I tell you that I am LIVING for this product! First of all, the texture; it is so soothing, creamy, and hydrating without being sticky. An issue I encounter is products that are too watery to keep my skin from drying, or are heavy and sticky and leave me feeling cakey. But this moisturizer absorbs perfectly into the skin without leaving you high and dry! I can use it morning or night. I am also someone who is very sensitive to fragrances, but I don't like to smell "sterile". This moisturizer is the perfect balance. My face smells like I visited a spa and treated myself without breaking me out. I would recommend this, highly, to anyone looking for a change in their skin routine! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream at night, and I absolutely love it! The texture is smooth and lightweight, making it easy to apply before bed without feeling greasy or heavy. By morning, my skin feels deeply hydrated, soft, and refreshed. I also love the subtle, pleasant scent—it's gentle and not overpowering. This cream has quickly become a staple in my nighttime routine, and it leaves my skin looking healthy and radiant every day. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes. I've been really impressed with the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream — it gives such a beautiful, effortless finish that makes your skin look naturally radiant. The texture is super lightweight and hydrating, like a refreshing cloud of moisture that instantly sinks in without feeling sticky or heavy. It's honestly one of the best "no makeup makeup" base creams I've tried.

avis.titre: The perfect prep for flawless makeup!
avis.texte: I have been using the Hyper Real Skincanvas™ Waterlight Cream in my morning routine, and it is a game-changer for my makeup. The texture is very nourishing and leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated. It is the best primer I've found; it keeps my foundation from cracking and makes it look flawless all day. However, I did notice that on very hot days or during the summer, the texture can feel a little bit heavy for daily wear if you prefer a weightless feel. Even so, for days when I need extra moisture and a perfect makeup base, it's my top choice. I liked it because i have very dry skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Matte, smooth and so comfy skin
avis.texte: I've been using this cream for a while now and it honestly surprised me in a good way. The texture feels rich at first, but once you apply it, it melts into the skin and becomes absolutely lightweight. The finish is more on the matte side, but without feeling dry at all, the hydration is definitely still there. My skin feels comfortable, smooth and well moisturized throughout the day. I also noticed that it actually softens the look of pores a bit, which I didn't really expect from a cream. It didn't cause any reactions on my fairly sensitive skin, which is a big plus for me. I also really love the fresh, slightly sweet scent: very subtle and pleasant. And can we talk about the packaging? The minimalistic, heavy jar feels so luxurious and expensive in your hands. Makeup applies beautifully on top of it, everything goes on smoothly, no pilling, no patchiness. It's one of those moisturizers that makes your skin feel prepped, balanced and just really nice. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Hydrated my skin for makeup so well
avis.texte: I thought this would mess up my makeup and cause pilling but clearly I was wrong. It was so hydrating, rather perfect for combination skin during the winter! It's not thick or thin but perfectly in the middle which saved my makeup from pilling. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This skincare cream did its magic on my skin. I washed my face first to have a clean face and applied the moisturizer in the morning and night like it was told on the directions of the box. I did this daily and I could see my skin was more hydrated and vibrant. I would highly recommend this product since it worked well on my skin. For better outcomes, I used ice water to clean my face before applying the moisturizer. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

MAC's SkinCanvas WaterLight moisturizer ilives up to its name as a lovely, lightweight base layer moisturizer before make up and a full day of responsibilities, or fun! It feels truly lightweight, leaves no greasy layer, and has no off-putting scents like some face creams. I don't necessarily love it as a daily general moisturizer, so as great as it has been for me under makeup, I do wish the performance felt more multipurpose... but the name clearly says "SkinCanvas" so I wasn't surprised by this, but for me that's really the only real drawback I've experienced with the WaterLight cream. Disclaimer: I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Hyper Real skin canvas water light cream moisturizer
avis.texte: This moisturizer works so good, I use it in the morning and at night and it makes my skin feel very hydrated. It doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or greasy. The smell is not to strong so it's perfect for a moisturizer. I received this product from MAC cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Excellent moisturizing cream for everyday use
avis.texte: I use this cream in the morning and sometimes in the evening when my skin needs extra hydration. It feels very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any heavy or greasy feeling. My skin looks fresher, smoother, and has a natural glow after application. I especially like how well my makeup applies on top, everything looks more even and polished. The scent is soft and not overpowering I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely loved the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream. The texture is lightweight yet deeply moisturizing, and it feels very comfortable on the skin from the moment you apply it. What impressed me the most is that the hydration lasts even into the next day. After using a small amount consistently, I noticed my skin looked calmer and more balanced, and the redness from my rosacea seemed to improve over time. My skin feels healthier, more supple, and has a natural glow. Overall, I'm genuinely impressed with the quality and performance of this moisturizer. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

This is such a nice lightweight moisturizer. I love using this as a primer for my makeup. It creates a really nice, hydrated base. I have dry skin and this keeps my skin hydrated through the whole day. I like the added strength this gives my skin barrier. It's a nice texture that absorbs into my skin easily. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

I absolutely love this moisturizer. My skin has been so dry and I love using this morning and night. It wears well under makeup or on its own and gives my skin a glowy finish. A little goes a long way yet it feels light on my skin. Will definitely repurchase when I run out. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

It's an amazing product it's very hydrating and leaves my skin looking so good I don't even feel like I need makeup and it doesn't peal my makeup or make it patchy like others do I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."

I loved this! I will absolutely recommend. I now use this everyday and have told all my friends they have to get it! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.
I liked this product! Makes my skin feel nice, and I have pretty stubbornly dry skin. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Hyper Real Skincanvas Waterlight Cream HA3 Moisturizer
avis.texte: I've used this moisturizer mostly in the morning underneath my makeup. The texture feels lightweight and melts into the skin without any greasy residue. My skin instantly felt hydrated and smoother, and it is perfect for using underneath makeup. The scent is very subtle and clean. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Great for all skin types even sensitive skin
avis.texte: Did you use it in the morning or at night? In the Morning when I wake to complete my skin routine put make up on afterwards. How did it feel on your skin? It felt amazingly smooth with richly moisturizer.. There is not much of a scent. it felt like my skin was hydrated all day. I received this product for free as a sample and for my review.

This moisturizer is excellent in terms of hydration and creating a smooth canvas in preparation for makeup application. It contains everything needed for hydration and barrier support like niacinamide, ceramides and HA.

This cream is lightweight and absorbs fast. It's hydrating and does everything I expect from a moisturizer. The only thing I would change about it is I wish it smelled better. It has a neutral, light chemical scent which I personally would have preferred to have a light, fresh scent like cucumber or something aquatic. But aside from that, this is a good moisturizer. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream mostly in the morning as part of my skincare routine before makeup, and I'm really impressed. The texture is incredibly lightweight and almost gel-cream like, but it delivers instant hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling smooth, plump, and refreshed with a healthy glow. There's a very subtle, clean scent that isn't overpowering at all. My makeup sits beautifully on top—no pilling, just a smooth, hydrated base. It feels luxurious yet breathable, perfect for everyday wear. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I've been using this MAC Waterlight cream for a few weeks now and it has become a staple in my daily skincare routine. I've always had dry skin on my face and I've tried many products most leave my skin feeling greasy, looking greasy and/or not hydrated enough. It's very lightweight, silky and absorbs quickly. Leaving my face feeling soft, hydrated and protected. I will definitely keep using this as a daily skincare product. "I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes."

This is the perfect moisturizer! It is so soft and lightweight on my skin and I don't feel it at all. I love that it isn't sticky on my skin and feels very nice and gentle. After just 3 days of using it, my skin had a more radiant glow and looked relatively smoother. This moisturizer is gentle on the skin, feels so luxurious, and delivers noticeable and amazing results with a few uses. This impressed me so much!!! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I've tried my fair share of moisturizers, but the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream truly stands out! From the moment I held that jar in my hands I could feel the difference - this has such a light fragrance that smells of quality product. Ive have been using this in my daily morning routine for over 2 weeks now. The texture is incredibly lightweight yet deeply hydrating, leaving my skin feeling soft and refreshed without any greasy residue. I love how it absorbs quickly, giving my skin a natural, dewy glow. It doesn't clog my pores or cause oiliness by the end of the day - which is a huge win for me, as I struggle with combination skin. What makes this moisturizer even more amazing is how it creates the perfect canvas for makeup. My foundation applies smoothly, and my skin looks radiant all day long. I've noticed that my skin feels smoother and more hydrated after just a few days of use. I can't recommend this moisturizer enough—it's definitely the new must-have in my skincare routine. If you're looking for something that hydrates, preps, and enhances your skin's natural glow, the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is absolutely worth it. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is my go-to morning moisturizer. I applied it at 8am and my skin stayed hydrated through 8pm. The texture is lightweight, absorbs fast, and leaves a smooth, radiant finish without feeling greasy or heavy under makeup. It feels comfortable and fresh all day long. The only thing I did not enjoy was the fragrance it had but it could be that I'm used to non-fragranced skincare. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer, works well with makeup
avis.texte: I always need a moisturizer on, especially during the winter months, but I've dealt with so many that don't sit well under my makeup. This MAC moisturizer works great! It is lightly scented, sort of a refreshing floral, very pleasant in my opinion. I can smell it when I apply, but not long after that. It is a nice middle-ground consistency, not too thick but without being excessively watery. It goes on smoothly and coolly. Both my daily BB cream and my higher coverage YSL foundation look great with this moisturizer (sometimes +YSL primer). It helps prevent patchy spots and flaky skin I sometimes get. Of course, it's no miracle cure-all and doesn't last 24hr, but for daily wear to work or going out, it definitely does its job. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

I loved that I received it during the winter because I am actually looking for a hydrating/moisturizing moisturizer cream that can also serve as a pretty good base under make-up and I am so glad I tried it. The scent was so nice and fresh, like the perfect scent for skincare. Texture is pretty good too, easy to apply, melts in your skin, and leaves the skin with a dewy glow. I was thinking why it was called "Hyper Real Skincanvas" but understood when I did put make-up on. It's a really good base and does the job of keeping the skin moisturized especially during the winter! I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Works well with my skin, thick consistency
avis.texte: This moisturizer works well and does not break my skin out which is usually a concern when trying new skincare. This did not cause any issues. I apply this in the morning alone or under makeup and also before bed after cleansing. I feel like it does a good job of giving me a barrier on my skin. The only issue I note is that (possibly just a me problem) it does not keep skin feeling supple for very long after. It soaks in rather quickly, and my lunchtime my face feels like I did not apply anything. Some people may like that, but I feel this would be best for someone with oily skin. Overall the product works well, and I will continue using it. It is a good amount of product for the price. There is no notable smell to the moisturizer. I would not recommend it for anyone with dry skin, though! I received this product from Mac cosmetics for free for testing and review purposes.

I've used the MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream for a little over two weeks now. It's very hydrating and my skin feels soft, glowy, and plump without additional greasiness (I have very oily skin). However, the scent is quite strong for my preference so I likely won't use daily and definitely not at night.

This moisturizer felt so good on my skin. I loved the finish and it made my makeup look so good is my go to before I apply my makeup because it just finishes the look and make it look flawless. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes

I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes. I love this moisturizer as a makeup base. No pilling, no slipping, no weird texture issues — everything goes on smoothly over it. It has no scent, which I appreciate, and it still somehow feels really luxurious on the skin. Lightweight but effective, and my skin looks fresh and balanced every time I use it.

I normally prefer a low fragrance moisturizer that does not contain perfume. This cream has a very strong fragrance that is not all natural/ extracts, though the fragrance does not linger for too long. It goes on a little oily feelings but it dries down well and leaves the skin glowy. It doesn't feel heavy. I would say this is a cream more suited for dry skin, not oily or combo. I applied this moisturizer at night and it layers well with other products with no pilling. Overall, I would recommend this cream for anyone who like a fragrant face moisturizer and who has drier skin - it's just not for me. avis.titre: My go-to for prepping skin for makeup!
avis.texte: This is my new favorite! MAC Hyper Real SkinCanvas Waterlight Cream is absolutely amazing! The texture is airy-light, melting right into my skin, fully absorbing without any greasy or oily shine that I hate. The peony scent is just wow- so gorgeous, it elevates the whole experience.✨ It feels incredibly lightweight yet hydrating. My skin looks so smooth afterwards. It creates the perfect smooth base, blurring my pores and prepping my skin before I apply foundation. My makeup actually looks 10x better and lasts longer too. The results have been amazing, my skin is not only smoother it's also softer and has a radiant glow. My large pores and harsh smile lines have since diminished. And my skin tone looks more even. If your prone to breakouts from skincare products not to worry this moisturizer is extremely gentle, it hasn't clogged my pores or caused any breakouts even with multiple uses per day. Honestly my skin has never looked better! If you want a moisturizer that improves your skin and layers beautifully under makeup, I definitely recommend this! avis.texte: I have combination skin with an oily t-zone and dry cheeks, that is a little more dehydrated now in the winter, and while this moisturizer felt hydrating at first I found my skin felt dry again a few hours later. The cream feels great to apply and it left a smooth finish that makeup applied really well on top. A bummer that it isn't working for my more dehydrated skin for the entire day. I think it would work better if you are more oily or live in a less dry climate. I have a feeling this will work much better for my skin in the summer months. I received this product for free from MAC Cosmetics for testing and review purposes.

avis.texte: I've been using the Hyper Real SkinCanvas™ Waterlight Cream both morning and night, and it fits well into a daily skincare routine. My skin looked smooth, radiant, and perfectly glowy, and this is definitely a product I will continue using under my makeup this year.
